logp.method_description: The distribution coefficient for each HPLC-purified radiocomplex was determined using the “shake-flask” method. (8) Each radiocomplex (500 μL in PBS, 0.4–3.7 MBq, 10–100 μCi) was added to a mixture of 4.5 mL of PBS (1 mM, pH 7.4) and 5 mL of 1-octanol. The resulting solution was vortexed for 10 min and centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 10 min. The 1-octanol and PBS layers were carefully separated, and 1 mL aliquots (n = 4) of each layer were counted on a HPGe detector or a NaI(Tl) well detector. The distribution coefficient was calculated by dividing the average counts in the 1-octanol layer by the average counts in the PBS layer. This experiment was repeated three times for each radiocomplex, and the results were expressed as an average of the log D7.4 values for the three experiments.
